title: DFSM Machine Definition (v1.0)
description: Canonical XState-aligned Durable Finite State Machine YAML/JSON specification for eklabdev/dfsm.

id.description: Unique identifier of the state machine.

type.description: Root machine state type. Defaults to 'compound'.

initial.description: Initial child state key when root type is 'compound'.

effects.description: Optional machine-level list of registered effect handlers (e.g. sub-effects invoked conditionally via runEffect) verified on machine creation when registry.strict is true.

maxEffectChainDepth.description: Maximum nested effect / automatic transition chain depth per transaction (default 25).

states.description: Map of state names to state node definitions. A top-level 'error' final state is automatically injected if omitted.

RegistryConfig.description: Configures how transition, compensation, and effect handlers are resolved from the Singleton FSMRegistry.

namespace.description: Namespace prefix used when resolving handler names in FSMRegistry (e.g. 'orders.checkout').

strict.description: When true (default), fails fast if any referenced transition, compensate, effect, or hook handler is not registered in FSMRegistry.

oneOf.description: Single registered lifecycle hook handler key in FSMRegistry.
Ordered list of registered lifecycle hook handler keys in FSMRegistry.

MachineHooksConfig.description: Transaction lifecycle hook handler bindings resolved from FSMRegistry upon machine creation.

onStart.description: Invoked after startTransaction persists the initial state.

beforeTransition.description: Invoked after pre-step input validation passes and before step execution.

afterTransition.description: Invoked after each transition step commits to StateStore.

onCompensate.description: Invoked after each LIFO Saga compensation step executes.

onComplete.description: Invoked when a transaction reaches COMPLETED.

onTerminal.description: Invoked when a transaction settles into any terminal status (COMPLETED, COMPENSATED, FAILED).

strategy.description: Delay progression algorithm between retry attempts.

initialDelayMs.description: Base delay in milliseconds before the first retry.

maxDelayMs.description: Upper bound in milliseconds on computed backoff delay.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum total execution attempts (1 = no retries, 4 = 1 initial call + up to 3 retries).

enabled.description: Whether circuit breaker protection is active for this transition.

key.description: Optional shared circuit breaker identifier. Defaults to '<machineId>:<statePath>:<event>'.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive or windowed failures required to trip the breaker to OPEN.

slidingWindowSize.description: Number of recent outcomes tracked in CLOSED state.

openDurationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds the circuit remains OPEN before entering HALF_OPEN.

halfOpenMaxCalls.description: Number of probe calls allowed in HALF_OPEN before closing the circuit.

compensate.description: When true, unwinds the transaction's persisted compensation stack in LIFO order upon terminal transition failure.

target.description: Alternative state target on failure (e.g. 'error', sibling state, or '#machineId.path'). Defaults to top-level 'error'.

enabled.description: Whether execution timing and telemetry are emitted to the BenchmarkLogEngine.

oneOf.description: Shorthand target state reference for pure state transitions without a custom function.

target.description: Target state (sibling name, relative dot-path, or '#<machineId>.<path>'). Optional if the transition function dynamically returns targetState or performs an internal self-transition.

transition.description: Registered transition function key in Singleton FSMRegistry.

compensate.description: Registered compensation function key pushed onto the transaction's Saga stack when this step succeeds.

effects.description: Registered side-effect handler keys invoked after state persistence.

type.description: State node classification. Inferred as 'compound' when 'states' is present and 'atomic' otherwise.

initial.description: Initial child state key (required for 'compound' states).

entry.description: Effect handler keys invoked upon entering this state.

exit.description: Effect handler keys invoked upon exiting this state.

on.description: Event-to-transition mappings handled by this state.

onDone.description: Automatic transition fired when a 'compound' child or all 'parallel' child regions enter a 'final' state.
